notes: METHOD. Lists read 10.10.2026 in a real browser: The 50 Best Hotels 2026 (the50.com, ranks 1-100), Travel + Leisure World's Best Awards 2026 Top 100 (published July 7, 2026), MICHELIN Keys Thailand (71 hotels, both pages). UNVERIFIED: Condé Nast Readers' Choice and Tripadvisor pages could not be loaded (404 / blocked) and the web-search budget for this turn was exhausted, so those two appear only as quoted on lebua's own site. Unsplash: /napi/search/photos inside a real Chrome page for ~90 hotel/brand queries, each result's /napi/photos/{id} location read, plus the full portfolios of uploaders who had hotel-tagged Thai photos (frugalflyer 577, nspehler, antonioaaaraujo 834, setsj 1170, others). Unsplash search is fuzzy, so a photo counted only when its location tag or uploader caption named the hotel, or it plainly shows it (State Tower's golden dome). Contact sheets checked by eye. FINDING. No hotel on the 50 Best list or among the T+L top Thai resorts (Capella, Four Seasons Bangkok, Mandarin Oriental, Six Senses Yao Noi, Anantara Golden Triangle, Rosewood Bangkok, The Nai Harn, Anantara Layan) has more than one free identifiable Unsplash photo; neither does any Phuket/Krabi/Samui MICHELIN Keys resort. The only hotel with list evidence AND 5+ good free photos is lebua at State Tower: T+L World's Best 2026 No.94 (and, per its own site, T+L 2025 No.72 and No.3 in Bangkok), with 13 identifiable free photos from 9 uploaders, 4 of them strong portraits. Conrad Koh Samui (12) and W Koh Samui (10) have more photos, but all from one hotel blogger, all 4:3 landscape, mostly overcast, and neither is on any list checked. Andaz Pattaya has a MICHELIN Key and 9 free photos, but they are mostly flower/moon details. COMPROMISE: lebua is a city tower hotel, not a beach resort like Cavo Tagoo; it is the pick because it is the only one that passes both gates, and its rooftop/Hangover story is the visual hook. Slides 3-5 photos are landscape and need a 3:4 crop (all 5000+ px wide, enough for 1080x1440). The view/sunset shots are tied to the hotel by uploader caption ('Bangkok view from Lebua Hotel', 'View from Lebua Sky Bar', Hangover filming spot), not by a visible hotel element; X35j61o3Cb0's exact terrace (Sky Bar vs Alfresco 64) is unverified, so it is not used. VOICE. Lines follow 04-hebrew-voice.md: short, no periods, emoji at line end from the creator set, אתם/שלכם, no ביותר, no price or superlative claims (the hotel's own 'world's highest' claims were deliberately left out). Slide 5 mirrors the source's 'Sunset dinner anyone?'. 'הקומה ה64' keeps the digit glued the way a phone types (rule 17); lebua.com puts Sky Bar on the 64th floor (older guides say 63). The Israeli release title of the film was not verified, so the line uses 'הנגאובר 2'. The last slide keeps the English hotel name, as the source does. No VPN/proxy/browser/AI words, no Agoda/Booking, no agoda.com/booking.com page was loaded.
